svg.title: Pearl Federation
svg.desc: A glorious blue flag billowing upward, edged in gold, bearing the ivory Pearl symbol: a solid pilcrow-like left bowl beside an open serif P. A gold staff is crowned by a pearl finial. Transparent background. The name Pearl Federation appears beneath the flag in outlined lettering.
svg.metadata: Original flag design for Pearl Federation. Pearl emblem source: https://github.com/pearl-research-labs/pearl/blob/master/apps/apps/pearl-desktop-wallet/resources/pearl-logo.svg. Emblem contours follow the flag surface. All visible artwork is vector; no fonts or external images required.
